expect.gold_note: 核心为Wallen等2022年记录：490名PD患者与234名对照，粪便DNA深度shotgun测序，以ANCOM-BC和MaAsLin2两种方法均显著为疾病关联判据，并进行网络分析和功能分析。摘要所称超过30%发生丰度改变的对象是受测物种、基因和通路，不能转写为30%的患者由微生物致病或30%的总体疾病风险。研究提供人类疾病关联及可检验假说；即使摘要使用病理机制或disease permissive表述，也没有在此报告随机微生物干预、确定的因果方向或预防治疗获益。背景记录关联了菌群与粪便代谢物，并明确提醒因果关系尚待建立；它不能替代核心的测序及双方法筛选条件。Keshavarzian等近邻明确采用核糖体RNA基因扩增子测序并预测功能，不能冒充本案要求的深度shotgun研究。forbidden仅限制其作为合格核心答案，不禁止说明它的相关背景价值。

evidence_anchors.quote: We enrolled 490 PD and 234 control individuals, conducted deep shotgun sequencing of fecal DNA, followed by metagenome-wide association studies requiring significance by two methods (ANCOM-BC and MaAsLin2) to declare disease association, network analysis to identify polymicrobial clusters, and functional profiling.
evidence_anchors.supports: 支持：病例和对照人数、真实shotgun测序、双方法显著性要求以及网络和功能分析。不能支持：随机化干预、微生物变化先于发病的时间证据或无混杂的因果效应。

evidence_anchors.supports: 支持：超过30%的表述针对受测微生物特征的丰度改变。不能支持：将分母改为人群、患者或疾病风险，也不能把丰度关联解释为某菌必然致病。

evidence_anchors.quote: provide a broad foundation with a wealth of concrete testable hypotheses to discern the role of the gut microbiome in PD.
evidence_anchors.supports: 支持：作者将研究产出定位为进一步辨明微生物作用的可检验假说基础。不能支持：这些假说已全部得到人体因果或治疗试验验证。

evidence_anchors.quote: Several studies report the association between intestinal dysbiosis and Parkinson's disease, although a cause-effect relationship remains to be established.

evidence_anchors.quote: Mucosal-associated and feces microbiota compositions were characterized using high-throughput ribosomal RNA gene amplicon sequencing. Data were correlated with clinical measures of PD, and a predictive assessment of microbial community functional potential was used to identify microbial functions.
evidence_anchors.supports: 支持：近邻为扩增子测序与功能预测，测量方式明确不满足本案要求的深度shotgun数据。不能支持：将其预测功能称为直接测得的宏基因组功能，或否认该研究对PD菌群关联的背景价值。

expect.gold_note: 这是按独立审校M-01与用户授权进行的整案替换，不是原DeepConsensus案删除人类条件后的放行。原目标仅标识HG003，封闭语料未建立其人类身份，原案仍不能据此判为通过；不把它转成设计缺口案。新核心摘要直接明示human GM12878 Utah/Ceph cell line与MinION。初始91.2 Gb序列数据约对应30×理论深度；nanopore读段自身从头组装的NG50约3 Mb。新增超长读段的read N50严格大于100 kb、读长最高882 kb，额外覆盖5×后assembly NG50约6.4 Mb。按摘要近似数值派生：NG50绝对增加约3.4 Mb，终值约为初值2.13倍，相对增加约113%，不能称增加2.13倍或把read N50当assembly NG50。最终组装规模为2867 million bases，覆盖参考的85.8%；按该报告比例计算参考未覆盖部分为14.2%，不是错误碱基比例。组装准确率是在纳入互补短读段数据后严格超过99.8%，不可改成恰好99.8%、只靠nanopore就达此精度，或与参考覆盖率相减来计算性能增益。91.2 Gb是测序数据量，不能与最终组装规模混为同一对象；这些数字不证明无间隙、端粒到端粒、全二倍体解析或普遍临床准确率。近邻AK1研究采用SMRT、next-generation mapping、linked reads和BAC等路线，虽也是人类从头组装且给出contig/scaffold N50，仍不满足本案MinION超长读段增量比较，不能搬用其数值补齐核心。

evidence_anchors.quote: We report the sequencing and assembly of a reference genome for the human GM12878 Utah/Ceph cell line using the MinION (Oxford Nanopore Technologies) nanopore sequencer.
evidence_anchors.supports: 支持：同一摘要直接建立人类细胞系GM12878与MinION测序及组装的联系，闭合身份和技术条件。不能支持：把该身份转移给HG003或其他编号样本，也不能补充该细胞系未报告的来源属性。

evidence_anchors.quote: 91.2 Gb of sequence data, representing ∼30× theoretical coverage, were produced.
evidence_anchors.supports: 支持：初始序列数据量91.2 Gb和约30×理论覆盖深度。不能支持：这是最终组装长度、每个位置的实测覆盖都相同，或理论覆盖等于完整参考覆盖率。

evidence_anchors.quote: De novo assembly of nanopore reads alone yielded a contiguous assembly (NG50 ∼3 Mb). We developed a protocol to generate ultra-long reads (N50 > 100 kb, read lengths up to 882 kb). Incorporating an additional 5× coverage of these ultra-long reads more than doubled the assembly contiguity (NG50 ∼6.4 Mb).
evidence_anchors.supports: 支持：组装NG50约3至约6.4 Mb、额外5×超长读段，以及读段N50大于100 kb和最高882 kb；可据近似值派生约3.4 Mb、终值约2.13倍及相对增幅约113%。不能支持：将近似派生值报成精确实验效应，把终值倍数当增幅，或混用读段N50和组装NG50。

evidence_anchors.quote: The final assembled genome was 2,867 million bases in size, covering 85.8% of the reference.
evidence_anchors.supports: 支持：最终组装规模及85.8%的参考覆盖比例；在相同参考分母下其补集为14.2%。不能支持：14.2%是碱基错误率、全部缺失都属于某一种基因组区域，或组装规模等于原始测序数据量。

evidence_anchors.quote: Assembly accuracy, after incorporating complementary short-read sequencing data, exceeded 99.8%.
evidence_anchors.supports: 支持：准确率严格超过99.8%，且这一结果带有纳入互补短读段数据的前提。不能支持：只用nanopore即达此准确率、准确率恰等于99.8%，或该百分比与85.8%参考覆盖率具有相同分母。

evidence_anchors.quote: Here we report the de novo assembly and haplotype phasing of the Korean individual AK1 (ref. 1) using single-molecule real-time sequencing, next-generation mapping, microfluidics-based linked reads, and bacterial artificial chromosome (BAC) sequencing approaches.
evidence_anchors.supports: 支持：近邻有明确的人类个体组装背景，但方法是SMRT及其他映射、linked reads、BAC组合，不能替代本案MinION超长读段增量实验。不能支持：近邻属于非人类样本，或其组装及分相研究没有价值。

evidence_anchors.quote: Single-molecule sequencing coupled with next-generation mapping generated a highly contiguous assembly, with a contig N50 size of 17.9 Mb and a scaffold N50 size of 44.8 Mb, resolving 8 chromosomal arms into single scaffolds.
evidence_anchors.supports: 支持：近邻的17.9 Mb和44.8 Mb分别是contig N50与scaffold N50，存在容易错配的定量指标。不能支持：把这些数值当成目标研究的NG50前后值，或据跨研究摘要给出两种路线的直接性能排名。

tasks.baseline_query: For a review of multi-year liver-directed factor-VIII delivery in adults with haemophilia A, retrieve both early-phase clinical reports covering SPK-8011 and AAV5-hFVIII-SQ. For each vector, distinguish the treated cohort from follow-up subsets and extract the observation horizon, persistence of factor expression, bleeding or prophylaxis outcomes, and immune or other safety limitations. AAV5 delivery of factor IX for haemophilia B is not an eligible substitute. Compare the two reports without treating separate dose cohorts, follow-up periods or assays as a randomized head-to-head study, and state whether the abstracts justify ranking one vector as safer or more durable.

request.abstract: For a review of multi-year liver-directed factor-VIII delivery in adults with haemophilia A, retrieve both early-phase clinical reports covering SPK-8011 and AAV5-hFVIII-SQ. For each vector, distinguish the treated cohort from follow-up subsets and extract the observation horizon, persistence of factor expression, bleeding or prophylaxis outcomes, and immune or other safety limitations. AAV5 delivery of factor IX for haemophilia B is not an eligible substitute. Compare the two reports without treating separate dose cohorts, follow-up periods or assays as a randomized head-to-head study, and state whether the abstracts justify ranking one vector as safer or more durable.

expect.gold_note: 两个required均须覆盖，不能只找出其中一个。SPK-8011原始报告为18名血友病A男性的一至二期试验，中位安全观察36.6个月；两人因抗AAV衣壳细胞免疫反应丧失全部VIII因子表达，其余16人维持表达，其中12人随访超过两年。摘要报告年化出血率降低91.5%，对应原文annualized bleeding rate，不是VIII因子输注次数的变化，也不擅自添加treated限定；不能从前后中位出血率自行重算一个不同百分数冒充该报告的效应估计。结论的no major safety concerns不能抹掉免疫介导的表达丢失及摘要中的治疗相关不良事件。AAV5-hFVIII-SQ报告15名重度血友病A成人，最长三年；结果按剂量和观察期分层，七人三年时VIII因子表达中位20 IU/dL、六人两年时13 IU/dL。七人组的中位年化需治疗出血事件数（treated bleeding events）为0，六人组的中位年化出血事件率（bleeding events，原句没有treated限定）为0，不能抹平两者原文口径。七人组外源VIII因子年输注次数中位数从138.5降至0，六人组VIII因子年输注次数中位数从155.5降至0.5；这些次数不能专指预防性用药，也不等于出血次数。摘要结论另称这两个剂量组所有参与者均完全停止预防性VIII因子使用；这是独立于输注次数统计的结论，不与0.5次/年矛盾，也不能据此断言剩余输注的具体用途。两组观察期不能混并，中位数为0不等于每个人都无事件。摘要还报告三年时另两名较低剂量者表达低于1 IU/dL，不能概括为15人均获得相同持续表达。肝定向设计由work:10.1056/nejmoa2113708中同名AAV5-hFVIII-SQ载体的肝选择性启动子背景句补足；该记录为三期研究，不能将其受试者、随访、疗效或安全性结果移入早期15人报告，临床多年结果仍仅取两个required。两项核心试验各自的参与者、剂量分组、随访长度与检测语境不同，不构成随机直接比较，不足以给出跨载体安全性或持久性排名。AMT-060近邻明确是血友病B、IX因子，即使同为AAV5也不满足本案疾病和因子条件。剂量字符串照录原摘要，不自行恢复上标。所涉记录撤稿状态均为unknown，未作当前安全性、监管或出版社状态核验。

evidence_anchors.quote: In this phase 1-2 trial, we infused an investigational adeno-associated viral (AAV) vector (SPK-8011) for hepatocyte expression of factor VIII in 18 men with hemophilia A.
evidence_anchors.supports: 支持：SPK-8011、肝细胞VIII因子表达、18名血友病A男性与早期试验身份。不能支持：这是与另一载体直接随机比较的试验，或人群已覆盖所有血友病亚型。

evidence_anchors.quote: The median safety observation period was 36.6 months (range, 5.5 to 50.3).
evidence_anchors.supports: 支持：该队列安全观察的中位数和范围。不能支持：所有18人均观察36.6个月或均超过两年，也不能等同另一试验的最长三年随访。

evidence_anchors.quote: Two participants lost all factor VIII expression because of an anti-AAV capsid cellular immune response that was not sensitive to immune suppression. evidence_anchors.supports: 支持：免疫介导表达丢失、16人维持表达及其中12人超过两年随访，三个分母不可混用。不能支持：全部受试者都持续表达，或免疫抑制在每位受试者中都能预防表达丢失。

evidence_anchors.quote: The participants had a 91.5% reduction (95% CI, 88.8 to 94.1) in the annualized bleeding rate
evidence_anchors.supports: 支持：该摘要报告的annualized bleeding rate相对降低及其置信区间，原句未加treated限定。不能支持：将91.5%当作因子输注次数或预防用药的降低、相对另一载体的优势，或直接用两个中位数重算替代该估计。

evidence_anchors.quote: We report durable efficacy, long-term safety, and clinical and biologic results in 15 adults with severe hemophilia A (factor VIII level, ≤1 IU per deciliter) who had received a single infusion of AAV5-hFVIII-SQ at various dose levels. We evaluated the factor VIII level, annualized rate of bleeding events, use of factor VIII, safety, expression kinetics, and biologic markers of AAV transduction for up to 3 years.
evidence_anchors.supports: 支持：第二个必要报告的15人队列、疾病严重度、多剂量单次输注与最长三年观察。不能支持：所有人均获得三年随访，或剂量组之间已按随机比较证明优劣。

evidence_anchors.quote: Seven participants (who had received 6×1013 vg per kilogram) had a median factor VIII expression of 20 IU per deciliter; the median number of annualized treated bleeding events was 0, and the median use of exogenous factor VIII was reduced from 138.5 infusions to 0 infusions per year.
evidence_anchors.supports: 支持：同摘要三年结果段中七人组的VIII因子表达、年化需治疗出血事件数中位数为0，以及外源VIII因子年输注次数中位数138.5至0。不能支持：删除treated限定、把输注次数专指预防用药、把中位数为0说成每人均无事件，或自行修复原始剂量上标。

evidence_anchors.quote: Two years after infusion, six participants (who had received 4×1013 vg per kilogram) had a median factor VIII expression of 13 IU per deciliter; the median annualized rate of bleeding events was 0, and the median use of factor VIII was reduced from 155.5 infusions to 0.5 infusions per year.
evidence_anchors.supports: 支持：两年六人组的年化出血事件率中位数为0，原句没有treated限定，VIII因子年输注次数中位数155.5至0.5。不能支持：把0.5解释为预防性输注或出血事件数、把两年改为三年，或将其与七人组混为同一观察期；剂量字符串仅照录。

evidence_anchors.quote: No inhibitor development, thromboses, deaths, or persistent changes in liver-function tests were observed.
evidence_anchors.supports: 支持：这项报告在所述观察中未见所列事件。不能支持：没有任何不良事件、终身风险为零，或因此可判定比另一载体更安全。

evidence_anchors.quote: Gene therapy for hemophilia B aims to ameliorate bleeding risk and provide endogenous factor IX (FIX) activity/synthesis through a single treatment, eliminating the requirement for FIX concentrate. AMT-060 combines an adeno-associated virus-5 (AAV5) vector with a liver-specific promoter driving expression of a codon-optimized wild-type human FIX gene.
evidence_anchors.supports: 支持：易混近邻虽使用AAV5和肝特异启动子，但对应血友病B与IX因子，疾病和产物明确不符。不能支持：它可替代任一VIII因子报告，或不同血友病亚型之间可直接比较获益百分比。

evidence_anchors.quote: Valoctocogene roxaparvovec (AAV5-hFVIII-SQ) is an adeno-associated virus 5 (AAV5)-based gene-therapy vector containing a coagulation factor VIII complementary DNA driven by a liver-selective promoter.
evidence_anchors.supports: 支持：同名AAV5-hFVIII-SQ载体采用肝选择性启动子驱动VIII因子编码序列，补足肝定向设计的背景条件。不能支持：将这项三期研究的受试者、随访时间、疗效或安全性结果归入早期15人报告，也不能替代任一required目标。

evidence_anchors.quote: complete cessation of prophylactic factor VIII use in all participants who had received 4×1013 vg per kilogram or 6×1013 vg per kilogram of the gene therapy.
evidence_anchors.supports: 支持：摘要结论明确两个所述剂量组的所有参与者完全停止预防性VIII因子使用，证据独立于各组年输注次数中位数。不能支持：两组所有用途的因子输注次数都为零、剩余输注用途已知，或较低剂量的另两名受试者也满足同样结论；原剂量排版不修复。

expect.gold_note: 核心记录是ALN-GO1的临床前多物种研究：摘要说明其靶向glycolate oxidase以耗竭草酸合成底物，并在野生型小鼠、大鼠和非人灵长类中观察mRNA沉默、血清或尿glycolate变化，在PH1遗传小鼠和高草酸尿大鼠模型中报告尿草酸下降。单次给药的遗传PH1小鼠最高下降为50%，大鼠多次给药最高为98%；不能把两种模型、给药次数或终点混成一个人体效应值。摘要结尾只说这些结果为临床试验提供理由，研究角色和证据范围仍是临床前模型，不能推出患者肾功能获益或因果治愈。Lumasiran记录则是6岁及以上PH1患者的双盲三期随机安慰剂试验，虽靶点同为glycolate oxidase，但它是人体临床证据，不能作为本案临床前研究的替代答案。所有结论仅依据摘要与元数据，不把unknown撤稿状态解释为撤稿或已排除撤稿。

evidence_anchors.quote: In this report, we discuss the development of ALN-GO1, an investigational RNA interference (RNAi) therapeutic targeting glycolate oxidase, to deplete the substrate for oxalate synthesis.
evidence_anchors.supports: 支持：候选物为RNAi，靶向glycolate oxidase并通过耗竭草酸合成底物发挥作用。不能支持：它已经在患者中获批或已证明能逆转肾衰竭。

evidence_anchors.quote: Subcutaneous administration of ALN-GO1 resulted in potent, dose-dependent, and durable silencing of the mRNA encoding glycolate oxidase and increased serum glycolate concentrations in wild-type mice, rats, and nonhuman primates.
evidence_anchors.supports: 支持：给药后mRNA沉默具有剂量依赖和持续性，并且涉及野生型小鼠、大鼠和非人灵长类。不能支持：这些动物药效等于患者剂量反应、长期安全性或人体临床获益。

evidence_anchors.quote: Notably, ALN-GO1 reduced urinary oxalate concentration up to 50% after a single dose in the genetic mouse model of PH1, and up to 98% after multiple doses in a rat model of hyperoxaluria.
evidence_anchors.supports: 支持：单次给药的小鼠模型最高50%、多次给药的大鼠模型最高98%，以及两个数字的模型和给药次数边界。不能支持：把98%外推到人体，或将两个模型结果合并成同一个临床试验终点。

evidence_anchors.quote: These data demonstrate the ability of ALN-GO1 to reduce oxalate production in preclinical models of PH1 across multiple species and provide a clear rationale for clinical trials with this compound.
evidence_anchors.supports: 支持：作者将证据定位为多物种PH1临床前模型，并认为其支持开展临床试验。不能支持：临床试验已经成功、患者获益已经确立，或动物结果直接证明因果治疗效果。

evidence_anchors.quote: In this double-blind, phase 3 trial, we randomly assigned (in a 2:1 ratio) patients with PH1 who were 6 years of age or older to receive subcutaneous lumasiran or placebo for 6 months
evidence_anchors.supports: 支持：易混近邻是6岁以上患者的双盲三期随机试验，与本案的动物临床前角色不同。不能支持：把lumasiran的临床设计或结果归给ALN-GO1的动物研究。

expect.gold_note: 核心为NanoVar方法论文：目标是低深度（8X）Oxford Nanopore全基因组数据上的结构变异调用，摘要说其在低深度模拟数据中与现有工具比较，并在患者样本中验证所表征的结构变异，同时发现健康个体的正常替代序列或等位基因。Longshot是容易误选的长读长近邻，但其摘要明确针对二倍体基因组中的单核苷酸变异检测与分相；长读长平台相同不等于变异类别和输出任务相同。不能把NanoVar摘要中的患者样本验证改写成普遍临床诊断准确率、对所有结构变异均适用，或把Longshot的SNV结果当成结构变异证据。

evidence_anchors.quote: Here, we present NanoVar, an optimized structural variant caller utilizing low-depth (8X) whole-genome sequencing data generated by Oxford Nanopore Technologies.
evidence_anchors.supports: 支持：核心方法是NanoVar，面向低深度8X Oxford Nanopore全基因组数据的结构变异调用。不能支持：它是单核苷酸变异分相器，或已在所有测序深度和平台上验证。

evidence_anchors.quote: NanoVar exhibits higher structural variant calling accuracy when benchmarked against current tools using low-depth simulated datasets.
evidence_anchors.supports: 支持：摘要报告低深度模拟数据上的结构变异调用准确性比较。不能支持：从该比较推导真实临床人群中的普遍准确率或所有工具、所有数据集上的排名。

evidence_anchors.quote: In patient samples, we successfully validate structural variants characterized by NanoVar and uncover normal alternative sequences or alleles which are present in healthy individuals.
evidence_anchors.supports: 支持：患者样本中的结构变异验证，以及健康个体正常替代序列或等位基因这一结果范围。不能支持：诊断了某种疾病、证明所有候选变异有临床意义，或存在未经摘要支持的前瞻性临床结局。

evidence_anchors.quote: We introduce a variant calling method, Longshot, which leverages the haplotype information present in SMS reads to accurately detect and phase single-nucleotide variants (SNVs) in diploid genomes.
evidence_anchors.supports: 支持：Longshot近邻的核心输出是二倍体基因组单核苷酸变异检测和分相，与本案结构变异调用条件不同。不能支持：因任务不同就断言Longshot在其SNV问题上无效。

evidence_anchors.quote: We demonstrate that Longshot achieves very high accuracy for SNV detection using whole-genome Pacific Biosciences data
evidence_anchors.supports: 支持：近邻的精度证据是全基因组PacBio数据上的SNV检测，进一步说明不能将其结果转成NanoVar的结构变异结论。不能支持：比较两个摘要而声称某一方法在所有长读长任务上更准确。

expect.gold_note: 核心为VAMB的宏基因组binning方法：深度变分自编码器在聚类前编码sequence coabundance和k-mer distribution，并将两类信息整合。摘要给出的相对结果是模拟数据中多29–98%、真实数据中多45%的near-complete genomes；这是相对现有binner的提升范围，不是绝对新增基因组数量。摘要还报告可分离到99.5% ANI的近缘菌株、从1000份人类肠道微生物组样本中分别重建255和91个Bacteroides样本特异NC genomes，并用2606个NC bins观察地理分布。不得把这些分母、对象层级或相对百分比混写，也不能把地理分布关联解释为微生物导致地理差异。metaMDBG是PacBio HiFi宏基因组组装器，摘要说复杂群落中最多得到两倍高质量环化原核MAG，任务是assembly而不是VAMB的binning；可作近邻但不满足核心条件。

evidence_anchors.quote: Here we develop variational autoencoders for metagenomic binning (VAMB), a program that uses deep variational autoencoders to encode sequence coabundance and k-mer distribution information before clustering.
evidence_anchors.supports: 支持：核心工具是面向宏基因组binning的深度变分自编码器，输入信息为序列共丰度与k-mer分布并在聚类前编码。不能支持：把它归类为PacBio读段组装器或只使用单一类型特征。

evidence_anchors.quote: VAMB outperforms existing state-of-the-art binners, reconstructing 29-98% and 45% more near-complete (NC) genomes on simulated and real data, respectively.
evidence_anchors.supports: 支持：模拟和真实数据对应的29-98%与45%相对提升，以及比较对象是binners。不能支持：这些百分比是绝对新增基因组数、适用于所有数据集，或可以从摘要推回基线总数。

evidence_anchors.quote: VAMB is able to separate closely related strains up to 99.5% average nucleotide identity (ANI), and reconstructed 255 and 91 NC Bacteroides vulgatus and Bacteroides dorei sample-specific genomes as two distinct clusters from a dataset of 1,000 human gut microbiome samples.
evidence_anchors.supports: 支持：99.5% ANI的菌株分离上限、两种Bacteroides的255和91个样本特异NC genomes，以及1000份人类肠道微生物组样本这一分母。不能支持：每个样本都含有这些基因组、ANI是检测准确率，或两种菌的数量是总体患病率。

evidence_anchors.quote: We use 2,606 NC bins from this dataset to show that species of the human gut microbiome have different geographical distribution patterns.
evidence_anchors.supports: 支持：地理分布观察使用2606个NC bins，结论是不同分布模式。不能支持：地理因素造成菌群差异的因果关系，或这些bins代表全部人类肠道微生物组。

evidence_anchors.quote: We introduce metaMDBG, a metagenomics assembler for PacBio HiFi reads.
evidence_anchors.supports: 支持：易混近邻是PacBio HiFi宏基因组组装器，而非本案所求的VAMB binning工具。不能支持：因其同属宏基因组软件就可替代VAMB的聚类和binner指标。

evidence_anchors.quote: For complex communities, we obtained up to twice as many high-quality circularized prokaryotic metagenome-assembled genomes as existing methods
evidence_anchors.supports: 支持：近邻报告的是复杂群落中高质量环化原核MAG的组装数量比较，任务和结果对象不同。不能支持：把最多两倍的assembly结果与VAMB的29-98%或45% binner提升直接换算或横向排名。

evidence_anchors.quote: IPA1 (Ideal Plant Architecture 1), a typical pleiotropic gene in rice that increases grains per panicle but reduces tillers.
evidence_anchors.supports: 支持：研究针对IPA1多效性带来的每穗籽粒数与分蘖数取舍。不能支持：所有调控IPA1的干预都必然同幅度改变两个性状，或已量化全部育种代价。

evidence_anchors.quote: In this study, we identified a 54-base pair cis-regulatory region in IPA1 via a tiling-deletion-based CRISPR-Cas9 screen that, when deleted, resolves the tradeoff between grains per panicle and tiller number, leading to substantially enhanced grain yield per plant.

evidence_anchors.quote: Mechanistic studies revealed that the deleted fragment is a target site for the transcription factor An-1 to repress IPA1 expression in panicles and roots.
evidence_anchors.supports: 支持：被删除片段与An-1对穗和根中IPA1表达的抑制有关。不能支持：在摘要未报告的组织中有相同作用，或已经排除所有其他调控机制。

tasks.baseline_query: For planning genome reconstruction from complex microbiomes, find two original method reports with different read strategies. The first should combine nanopore long-read assembly with short-read correction and include both a synthetic bacterial mixture and human stool samples. The second should assemble PacBio HiFi metagenomes using minimizer-space de Bruijn graphs, with explicit handling of coverage variation and strain complexity. Compare their input requirements and the reported evidence for closed or circularized genomes. Distinguish contiguity from nucleotide accuracy, keep each paper's counts and relative gains separate, and do not replace either assembler with a tool for phasing single-nucleotide variants in diploid genomes.

request.abstract: For planning genome reconstruction from complex microbiomes, find two original method reports with different read strategies. The first should combine nanopore long-read assembly with short-read correction and include both a synthetic bacterial mixture and human stool samples. The second should assemble PacBio HiFi metagenomes using minimizer-space de Bruijn graphs, with explicit handling of coverage variation and strain complexity. Compare their input requirements and the reported evidence for closed or circularized genomes. Distinguish contiguity from nucleotide accuracy, keep each paper's counts and relative gains separate, and do not replace either assembler with a tool for phasing single-nucleotide variants in diploid genomes.

expect.gold_note: 本案有两个互补子需求，两个required分别覆盖，必须同时检出而不能要求某一篇单独满足两条路线。Lathe结合nanopore长读段组装和短读段纠错：12种细菌合成混合物中7个基因组为单contig、另3个至多4个contigs；另在人类13份粪便样本中组装20个环状基因组。这些数值属于两个不同数据集合，不能合并为每样本20个，也不能声称12种都闭合；摘要还明确较替代路线核苷酸准确性下降，连续性改善不等于碱基准确率也改善。metaMDBG是PacBio HiFi组装器，以minimizer空间的de Bruijn图、迭代组装和丰度过滤处理覆盖变化及菌株复杂性；摘要报告复杂群落中高质量环化原核MAG数量最多达现有方法的两倍，并改善病毒和质粒恢复。该相对数值不能直接与Lathe的20个环状基因组比较，摘要也没有给出两工具在同一数据、同一预算下的直接排名。Longshot的摘要输出是二倍体SNV检测与分相，不是任一所需的宏基因组闭合组装路线。metaMDBG曾在第三批充当另一案的近邻，但不是此前required；本案不重复此前的VAMB binning问题。

evidence_anchors.quote: We applied nanopore sequencing and our workflow, named Lathe, which incorporates long-read assembly and short-read error correction, to assemble closed bacterial genomes from complex microbiomes.
evidence_anchors.supports: 支持：第一条路线的nanopore长读段组装、短读段纠错与复杂微生物组闭合细菌基因组用途。不能支持：仅长读段而无短读段纠错的输入假设，或所有样本均达到无误差闭合。

evidence_anchors.quote: We validated our approach with a synthetic mixture of 12 bacterial species. Seven genomes were completely assembled into single contigs and three genomes were assembled into four or fewer contigs.
evidence_anchors.supports: 支持：合成混合物12种细菌、7个单contig及另3个至多4个contigs的数量关系。不能支持：12种全部闭合，或把合成混合物结果当作人类粪便队列结果。

evidence_anchors.quote: Next, we used our methods to analyze metagenomics data from 13 human stool samples. We assembled 20 circular genomes, including genomes of Prevotella copri and a candidate Cibiobacter sp.
evidence_anchors.supports: 支持：13份人类粪便样本合计组装20个环状基因组及所述例子。不能支持：每份样本均有20个、20个代表全部群落成员，或这些基因组均有相同完整性指标。

evidence_anchors.quote: Despite the decreased nucleotide accuracy compared with alternative sequencing and assembly approaches, our methods improved assembly contiguity
evidence_anchors.supports: 支持：摘要明确区分核苷酸准确性下降与组装连续性提升。不能支持：把连续性获益当作碱基准确率获益，或无条件宣布该路线优于全部替代方法。

evidence_anchors.quote: We introduce metaMDBG, a metagenomics assembler for PacBio HiFi reads. MetaMDBG combines a de Bruijn graph assembly in a minimizer space with an iterative assembly over sequences of minimizers to address variations in genome coverage depth and an abundance-based filtering strategy to simplify strain complexity.

expect.gold_note: 库内缺少的是将患者或临床机构随机分配到CRISPR与常规PCR诊疗路径、再报告组间死亡结局的原始证据，不是CRISPR检测方法或临床样本数据完全不存在。Fozouni等报告免扩增Cas13a检测、手机显微镜读出与预提取阳性样本RNA的检测性能；CALIBURN-v2报告提取RNA上的25分钟诊断、便携设备和云端数据管理，以及野生型/变异株检测敏感度。这些都是相关技术近邻，仅作background，均不能满足随机诊疗策略与死亡结局这组必要条件。临床样本验证、试剂反应时间短和高敏感度不等于临床结局改善，也不能把提取后测量时间当作完整就诊到结果时间。全库标题摘要以CRISPR及Cas9/Cas12/Cas13/Cas3、SHERLOCK、DETECTR、CARMEN、clustered regularly等变体与SARS-CoV-2/COVID-19/coronavirus交集筛查得到34条候选，逐条核读摘要；未见符合随机分配的描述或随机对照pub_types，更未见所需的策略间死亡比较。该筛查未预先剔除禁用目标，因此缺口不是人为排除造成；没有把关键词零命中单独当成科学不存在证明。只可回答给定语料摘要未提供所需证据，不能声称现实世界没有试验、CRISPR不能改善临床结局，或这些近邻没有诊断研究价值。所有标注记录retraction_status为unknown，未据此作正反判断。

evidence_anchors.quote: Here, we report the development of an amplification-free CRISPR-Cas13a assay for direct detection of SARS-CoV-2 from nasal swab RNA that can be read with a mobile phone microscope.
evidence_anchors.supports: 支持：相关近邻建立Cas13a病毒检测与手机读出技术，符合快速检测主题。不能支持：患者或机构已随机分配诊疗路径，或已经测得策略间死亡率差异。

evidence_anchors.quote: The assay achieved ∼100 copies/μL sensitivity in under 30 min of measurement time and accurately detected pre-extracted RNA from a set of positive clinical samples in under 5 min.
evidence_anchors.supports: 支持：检测限、测量时间以及预提取阳性临床样本RNA的检测结果，说明已具备的证据层级。不能支持：小于五分钟是完整就诊流程耗时、死亡风险已降低，或该样本验证等同随机临床结局试验。

evidence_anchors.quote: This platform, which was referred to as CALIBURN-v2, could complete the diagnosis on extracted RNA samples within 25 min in a closed-lid reaction mode and had 100-fold increase in detection sensitivity in comparison with previous platforms.
evidence_anchors.supports: 支持：另一近邻的时间与敏感性指标基于提取RNA样本的检测平台比较。不能支持：这是随机分配医院诊疗策略的设计，或一百倍检测敏感性提升对应一百倍临床生存获益。

evidence_anchors.quote: It was found that IoMT-enabled CALIBURN-v2 could achieve 95.56% (172 out of 180) sensitivity for SARS-CoV-2 wild type and 94.38% (84 out of 89) overall sensitivity for SARS-CoV-2 variants including Delta and Omicron strains.
evidence_anchors.supports: 支持：记录报告野生型与变异株检测敏感度及各自样本分母。不能支持：把两组病毒样本当作随机诊疗组、将检测敏感度当作死亡率降低，或补写未提供的死亡事件数。
